# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r Import}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

C4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_fa_04_couple_04.sas7bdat")

M4_C0_bornes0 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_C0_bornes0.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```


## Corriger données d'identité

```{r C4_A0 to C4_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
C4_A1 <- C4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    ),
    sf_conjt_prenom = str_to_upper(sf_conjt_prenom),
    sf_conjt_prenom = replace_when(
      sf_conjt_prenom,
      sf_conjt_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

commentaires <- C4_A1 %>% 
  select(id_anonymat, id_doublon, id_keep, commentaires_fam) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    id_og = if_else(id_anonymat == id_doublon, 0, 1)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep, id_og) %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(id_doublon)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(!is.na(commentaires_fam))) %>% 
  fill(commentaires_fam,
       .direction = "up") %>% 
  select(id_keep, commentaires_fam) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

C4_A2 <- C4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(C4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_couple_cat), -couple_type) %>% 
  rows_patch(
    commentaires,
    by = "id_keep"
  )

rm(commentaires)

```

## Retirer les colonnes vides

```{r C4_A2 to C4_A3}

empty_cols_C4_A2 <- C4_A2 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(C4_A2))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_C4_A2$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
C4_A3 <- C4_A2 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides))

rm(list = c("empty_cols_C4_A2", "C4_A0", "C4_A1", "C4_A2", "vars_vides"))

```

## Garder que les colonnes du module

```{r C4_A3 to C4_B0}

C4_B0 <- C4_A3 %>% 
  relocate(
    c("id_date_nais", "id_sexe", "couple_date_creation", "couple_sf_couple_1an", "sf_couple_1an",
      "sf_conjt_prenom", "sf_conjt_sexe", "sf_conjt_mois_nais", "sf_an_conjt_nais",
      "sf_conjt_an_nais", "sf_nature_union", "sf_conjt_mois_union", "sf_conjt_an_union",
      "sf_conjt_muco", "sf_interromp", "sf_interromp_par", "sf_mois_interromp",
      "sf_an_interromp", "sf_raison_muco", "sf_conjt_enf", "commentaires_fam"), 
    .after = id_keep) %>% 
  select(-(id_date_creation:sf_matrimoniale)) %>% 
  mutate(
    sf_conjt_an_nais = replace_when(
      sf_conjt_an_nais,
      is.na(sf_conjt_an_nais) & !is.na(sf_an_conjt_nais) ~ sf_an_conjt_nais
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-sf_an_conjt_nais)

```


## Identifier les absents

```{r C4_B0 to C4_B1}

vars_check <- C4_B0 %>%
  select(sf_conjt_prenom:sf_conjt_enf) %>%
  colnames()

C4_B1 <- C4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    cp_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

## Retirer les doublons

```{r C4_B1 to C4_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons_1 <- C4_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat == id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  # Ajouter variable pour identifier doublons et permettre d'ordonner les lignes
  
  mutate(
    is_og = if_else(
      id_anonymat == id_doublon, 0, 1
    ),
    .after = couple_date_creation
  ) %>% 
  
  arrange(id_keep, is_og) %>% 
  
  # Remplir sf_couple_1an pcq vient du module famille
  
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  fill(sf_couple_1an,
       .direction = "up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-is_og)
  

# Garder que les lignes différentes ------------------------------------------------
  
doublons_2 <- doublons_1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les lignes pareilles
  distinct(
    pick(sf_conjt_prenom:sf_conjt_enf),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
  
  # Trouver ceux qui ont plus d'une ligne pour un conjoint avec meme prenom
  group_by(id_keep, sf_conjt_prenom) %>% 
  mutate(
    n = n()
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Trier parmis ceux qui ont renseigné plus d'une fois une meme relation --------

doublons_3 <- doublons_2 %>%
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n == 2) %>% 
  
  # Garder l'année d'union la plus ancienne
  filter(sf_conjt_an_union == min(sf_conjt_an_union)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Réunir les doublons ----------------------------------------------------------
doublons_4 <- doublons_2 %>% 
  
  # Retirer ceux qu'on a modifiés
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_3$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_3) %>% 
  
  # Retirer variable inutile
  select(-n) %>% 
  
  # Retirer un doublon completement vide
  filter_out(id_anonymat == "GCXSD")


# Corriger id_anonymat des doublons --------------------------------------------

doublons_corr <- doublons_4 %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  )

# Joindre les données propres
C4_C0 <- C4_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_1$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, sf_conjt_an_union, desc(sf_interromp))

rm(list = c("doublons_1", "doublons_2", "doublons_3", "doublons_4",
            "doublons_corr"))
rm(list = c("C4_A3", "C4_B0", "C4_B1"))


```

## Vérifier la variable borne 

```{r C4_C1 to C4_C2}

C4_C1 <- left_join(
  C4_C0,
  M4_C0_bornes0 %>% 
    select(id_keep, fa_complet, fa_cp_couple_1an),
  by = "id_keep"
) %>% 
  relocate(c("cp_complet", "fa_complet", "fa_cp_couple_1an", "sf_couple_1an",
             "couple_sf_couple_1an"), .after = couple_date_creation) 

C4_C2 <- C4_C1 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_cp_couple_1an = 1
  ) %>% 
  select(-sf_couple_1an, -couple_sf_couple_1an)




```


## Mettre à jour variable borne

```{r M4_C0_bornes0 to M4_C0_bornes2}

M4_C0_bornes1 <- M4_C0_bornes0 %>% 
  rows_update(
    C4_C2 %>% 
      select(id_keep, fa_cp_couple_1an) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    C4_C2 %>% 
      select(id_keep, cp_complet) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(cp_complet, .after = fa_cp_couple_1an) %>% 
  relocate(fa_complet, .before = fa_cp_couple_1an)

M4_C0_bornes2 <- M4_C0_bornes1 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_cp_couple_1an = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_cp_couple_1an) ~ fa_cp_couple_1an,
      is.na(fa_cp_couple_1an) & fa_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(fa_cp_couple_1an) & fa_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    cp_complet = replace_when(
      cp_complet,
      is.na(cp_complet) ~ 0
    )
  )


```

## Dernières corrections

### Vérifier dates de saisie
```{r Import2}

C4_C3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_C4_C3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)
```

```{r C4_C3 to C4_C4}

verif <- C4_C3 %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_lignes = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat, couple_date_creation) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_dates = n()
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  filter(any(n_lignes != n_dates)) %>% 
  relocate(c("n_lignes", "n_dates"), .after = couple_date_creation)

corr <- verif %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(couple_date_creation = min(couple_date_creation)) %>% 
  select(-n_lignes, -n_dates)

C4_C4 <- C4_C3 %>% 
  filter_out(id_anonymat %in% verif$id_anonymat) %>% 
  bind_rows(corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, sf_conjt_an_union, sf_interromp)
  
rm(list = c("verif", "corr", "C4_C3"))

```

## Corriger les NAs
```{r}

rcdSM_vars_simple1 <- function(df, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcdSM_vars_borne1 <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 0 ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

```

```{r C4_D2 to C4_D3}

vars_simples <- C4_D2 %>% 
  select(conjt_sexe:union_int, union_enf) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_int <- C4_D2 %>% 
  select(union_int_par:union_int_muco) %>% 
  colnames()

C4_D3 <- C4_D2 %>% 
  mutate(
    conjt_prenom = if_else(is.na(conjt_prenom), "-9", conjt_prenom)
  ) %>% 
  rcdSM_vars_simple1(all_of(vars_simples)) %>% 
  rcdSM_vars_borne1(union_int, all_of(vars_int))

rm(list = c("vars_simples", "vars_int", "rcdSM_vars_simple1",
            "rcdSM_vars_borne1"))
```
